methods.label: Subtract the overlap
methods.explanation: When events are not mutually exclusive, subtract the probability of their simultaneous occurrence: \(1/2+1/3-1/6=2/3\).
methods.levelReason: Uses the school-level addition formula for overlapping events and elementary mixed fraction arithmetic.

review.mathematicalCheck: Adding the event probabilities counts the intersection twice, so subtract it once: \(1/2+1/3-1/6=(3+2-1)/6=2/3\). The explanation states this decisive operation correctly.
